tools.name: cleardose_search_drug_index
tools.title: Search the Universal Drug Index
tools.description: Search ClearDose's local fictional Universal Drug Index by generic name, brand, category, drug class, or UDI id. Use this when the user needs candidate records or exact drug ids for another tool.

query.description: Raw search text such as lisinopril, Lipitor, Statin, or udi:cleardose:lisinopril.

category.description: Optional exact category returned by a prior search.

drugClass.description: Optional exact drug class returned by a prior search.

code.description: Stable failure code when ok is false.

retryable.description: Whether the request can succeed after the stated recovery.

tools.name: cleardose_get_drug_index_entry
tools.title: Get one Universal Drug Index entry
tools.description: Return normalized identity, class, package variants, and fictional price offers for one exact ClearDose UDI drug id. Use after search_drug_index identifies the record.

drugId.description: Exact ClearDose UDI drug id such as med_lisinopril.

code.description: Stable failure code when ok is false.

retryable.description: Whether the request can succeed after the stated recovery.

tools.name: cleardose_find_compatible_options
tools.title: Find explicitly compatible medication options
tools.description: Return the seeded ClearDose relationships that permit a same-medication provider comparison or a discussion-only clinician handoff. The result does not claim therapeutic equivalence or recommend substitution.

drugId.description: Exact ClearDose UDI drug id returned by search_drug_index.

purpose.description: The reason for checking compatibility. Eligibility differs by purpose.

code.description: Stable failure code when ok is false.

retryable.description: Whether the request can succeed after the stated recovery.

tools.name: cleardose_compare_medication_options
tools.title: Compare explicitly compatible medication options
tools.description: Compare structured facts and fictional provider offers for one to four exact UDI records after ClearDose confirms the requested relationship. Discussion-only records are not ranked as substitutes.

drugIds.description: One to four exact UDI drug ids. A single id compares providers for the same medication.

variantIds.description: Optional exact variant ids keyed by an id in drugIds.

code.description: Stable failure code when ok is false.

retryable.description: Whether the request can succeed after the stated recovery.

tools.name: cleardose_compare_drug_prices
tools.title: Compare fictional drug price offers
tools.description: Compare package and delivered-price offers for one to four exact UDI drug ids. Use for price facts only; different drugs are not treated as therapeutic substitutes.

drugIds.description: One to four exact ids returned by search_drug_index.

strength.description: Optional exact strength, such as 10mg. If unavailable, the tool returns the closest indexed package and names it explicitly.

quantity.description: Optional package quantity. If unavailable, the tool returns the closest indexed package and names it explicitly.

code.description: Stable failure code when ok is false.

retryable.description: Whether the request can succeed after the stated recovery.

tools.name: cleardose_find_related_drugs
tools.title: Find related drug index entries
tools.description: Find other UDI entries in the same broad demo comparison group as one exact drug id. Use the discussion-only matches to prepare questions for a clinician; every result explicitly states that it is not a therapeutic-equivalence or substitution recommendation.

drugId.description: Exact ClearDose UDI drug id returned by search_drug_index.

code.description: Stable failure code when ok is false.

retryable.description: Whether the request can succeed after the stated recovery.

tools.name: cleardose_get_drug_availability
tools.title: Get fictional provider availability
tools.description: Return deterministic stock, provider, pickup, shipping, and delivery facts for one exact indexed package at a seeded demo location. This does not contact a pharmacy or reserve inventory.

strength.description: Exact strength when variantId is omitted.

quantity.description: Exact package quantity when variantId is omitted.

code.description: Stable failure code when ok is false.

retryable.description: Whether the request can succeed after the stated recovery.

tools.name: cleardose_compare_drug_availability
tools.title: Compare fictional availability and delivery
tools.description: Rank seeded provider offers for one exact medication package by fictional price and fulfillment timing. Cross-medication candidates must pass the explicit fulfillment compatibility rules.

compatibleDrugIds.description: Optional candidates returned by find_compatible_options for fulfillment.

maxDeliveryDays.description: Optional latest acceptable fictional delivery day.

code.description: Stable failure code when ok is false.

retryable.description: Whether the request can succeed after the stated recovery.

tools.name: cleardose_estimate_delivery
tools.title: Estimate fictional package delivery
tools.description: Return one deterministic pickup or shipping estimate for an exact indexed package and seeded provider offer. The estimate is not a fulfillment promise.

offerId.description: Optional exact offer id returned by get_drug_availability.

providerId.description: Optional seeded provider id. Do not combine with offerId.

code.description: Stable failure code when ok is false.

retryable.description: Whether the request can succeed after the stated recovery.

tools.name: cleardose_review_demo_interaction_flags
tools.title: Review synthetic medication interaction flags
tools.description: Review two to ten exact UDI drug ids against ClearDose's intentionally incomplete synthetic interaction fixtures. Every result exposes coverage gaps and requires verification by a licensed pharmacist.

drugIds.description: Two to ten exact ClearDose UDI ids representing the medication list to review.

code.description: Stable failure code when ok is false.

retryable.description: Whether the request can succeed after the stated recovery.

tools.name: cleardose_build_procurement_plan
tools.title: Build a local fictional procurement plan
tools.description: Build a local-only plan for one to twelve requested UDI medications using fictional package offers. The result is planning-only and leaves prescription validation, inventory reservation, and ordering to human-controlled workflows.

items.description: Requested UDI records and optional exact package preferences.

drugId.description: Exact UDI drug id returned by search_drug_index.

strategy.description: How to select fictional offers: lowest delivered total, fewest channels, or a simple cost-and-speed balance.

code.description: Stable failure code when ok is false.

retryable.description: Whether the request can succeed after the stated recovery.

tools.name: cleardose_prepare_doctor_question_card_request
tools.title: Prepare a doctor question card handoff
tools.description: Resolve one UDI record, up to three related discussion-only records, and optional patient concerns into a bounded site-to-agent handoff. The result contains an instruction and exact response schema for a second tool call; it does not create clinical guidance.

drugId.description: Exact primary ClearDose UDI drug id.

relatedDrugIds.description: Zero to three discussion-only ids returned by find_related_drugs. Omit to use up to two indexed suggestions.

concerns.description: Zero to six short fictional concern prompts used only during this call. Never enter real health information. ClearDose persists only the count, not the authored text.

code.description: Stable failure code when ok is false.

retryable.description: Whether the request can succeed after the stated recovery.

tools.name: cleardose_submit_doctor_question_card_draft
tools.title: Submit a doctor question card draft
tools.description: Submit the structured response for an existing ClearDose question-card exchange. This stores a local draft for human review and derives all displayed fictional price facts from the UDI rather than agent text.

exchangeId.description: Exact exchange id returned by prepare_doctor_question_card_request.

title.description: Short neutral title for the patient-owned card.

questions.description: Two to eight neutral questions the patient may choose to ask a licensed clinician. Each item must end with a question mark.

code.description: Stable failure code when ok is false.

retryable.description: Whether the request can succeed after the stated recovery.

tools.name: cleardose_prepare_prescription_follow_up
tools.title: Prepare prescription-required follow-up
tools.description: Turn a prescription-required fulfillment gate into deterministic next steps and an editable prompt for patient review. This tool does not contact a prescriber, transfer a prescription, or make a clinical recommendation.

questions.description: Optional short questions to preserve in the editable handoff.

code.description: Stable failure code when ok is false.

retryable.description: Whether the request can succeed after the stated recovery.

tools.name: cleardose_prepare_agent_memory_packet
tools.title: Prepare a user-controlled agent memory packet
tools.description: Create a bounded Markdown and structured context packet for the user to review, edit, copy, or save locally. The tool does not write to an external agent memory or filesystem automatically.

code.description: Stable failure code when ok is false.

retryable.description: Whether the request can succeed after the stated recovery.

tools.name: cleardose_inspect_workflow_runtime
tools.title: Inspect local workflow runtime
tools.description: Read recent ClearDose workflow instances, transitions, bounded context snapshots, generated cards, and the local DuckDB-Wasm status. Use this to explain what the site and agent have completed without changing state.

flowId.description: Optional exact flow id. Omit it to inspect concurrent recent flows.

code.description: Stable failure code when ok is false.

retryable.description: Whether the request can succeed after the stated recovery.

tools.name: cleardose_inspect_workflow_state
tools.title: Inspect one workflow state
tools.description: Return one local workflow's current state, version, state metadata, valid agent actions, human-only actions, and disabled actions without changing it.

flowId.description: Exact flow id returned by inspect_workflow_runtime.

outputSchema.description: Current state and declared actions for one local workflow.

code.description: Stable failure code when ok is false.

retryable.description: Whether the request can succeed after the stated recovery.

tools.name: cleardose_get_workflow_history
tools.title: Get one workflow event history
tools.description: Return up to one hundred chronological events for one exact local workflow, including bounded context snapshots and stable event versions.

limit.description: Maximum most-recent events to return in chronological order.

outputSchema.description: Bounded chronological history for one local workflow.

code.description: Stable failure code when ok is false.

retryable.description: Whether the request can succeed after the stated recovery.

tools.name: cleardose_get_available_workflow_actions
tools.title: Get available workflow actions
tools.description: List every valid agent action, human-only action, and unavailable action for one exact local workflow state without dispatching anything.

outputSchema.description: Valid, human-only, and unavailable actions for one workflow state.

code.description: Stable failure code when ok is false.

retryable.description: Whether the request can succeed after the stated recovery.

tools.name: cleardose_get_workflow_transition
tools.title: Inspect one workflow transition
tools.description: Explain one declared action, its source and target state, input schema, availability, human-control status, and recovery metadata without dispatching it.

action.description: Declared action name such as COMPARE.

outputSchema.description: One declared workflow transition and its current availability.

code.description: Stable failure code when ok is false.

retryable.description: Whether the request can succeed after the stated recovery.

tools.name: cleardose_dispatch_workflow_transition
tools.title: Dispatch one local workflow transition
tools.description: Dispatch one declared agent action against the exact observed workflow version. The runtime validates the action-specific input, rejects stale state, and blocks human-only transitions.

input.description: Action-specific input. Its selected transition schema performs the final validation.

requestId.description: Unique idempotency id for this dispatch.

outputSchema.description: Result of one versioned local workflow mutation.

code.description: Stable failure code when ok is false.

retryable.description: Whether the request can succeed after the stated recovery.

tools.name: cleardose_reset_workflow_state
tools.title: Reset one local workflow state
tools.description: Reset one local workflow to its declared initial state using the exact observed version and a unique request id. Existing history remains available.

requestId.description: Unique idempotency id for this reset.

outputSchema.description: Result of one versioned local workflow mutation.

code.description: Stable failure code when ok is false.

retryable.description: Whether the request can succeed after the stated recovery.

tools.name: cleardose_highlight_section
tools.title: Highlight a visible ClearDose section
tools.description: Move keyboard focus to and visibly highlight one stable section on the current ClearDose page so the user and agent can discuss the same content.

target.description: Stable section identifier. If the section is not on the current page, the tool returns a clear non-retryable error.

code.description: Stable failure code when ok is false.

retryable.description: Whether the request can succeed after the stated recovery.

tools.name: cleardose_get_cart
tools.title: Read the local ClearDose cart
tools.description: Read the current fictional ClearDose cart with item-level and total prices. This tool does not change state or expose customer profile data.

code.description: Stable failure code when ok is false.

retryable.description: Whether the request can succeed after the stated recovery.

tools.name: cleardose_add_to_cart
tools.title: Add one indexed package to the local cart
tools.description: Add one exact fictional UDI medication package to the local ClearDose cart. Use get_drug_index_entry first to obtain the exact drugId and variantId. This changes only resettable browser demo state.

drugId.description: Exact UDI drug id returned by get_drug_index_entry.

variantId.description: Exact package variant id returned by get_drug_index_entry.

outputSchema.description: Result of adding one exact package to the local mock cart.

code.description: Stable failure code when ok is false.

retryable.description: Whether the request can succeed after the stated recovery.
